repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Stat catalogue has no rare-event PN/PS honest-inference frontier, and scm_mediator_monotonicity_pn_v1 is a distinct mediator partial-ID kernel.

published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 gives regular efficient PN/PS inference; ZhangWangMiao2025 gives efficient inference for generally partially identified PN bounds, not a learned rare-count point-PN likelihood-ratio frontier.
TianWu2025 derives the monotone-PN efficient influence function and regular large-sample theory; the triangular-array extension is methodologically close.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the finite-expected-diameter impossibility template and CaiGuo2017 supplies honest expected-length methodology; neither states the bounded monotone-PN submodel rate.
Huwang1995 establishes nonuniform coverage failure for a normal-approximation binomial interval; the rare-cell Poisson limit is a standard multinomial specialization after fixing the PN submodel.

HannartNaveau2018 maximizes causal evidence when defining climate events, but does not provide selection-honest learned score-cell inference; KirilioukNaveau2020 is an extreme-value-model comparator rather than such a theorem.

structure_flags.label: thm:lr-frontier
structure_flags.one_line: The proposed kernel and strongest result is an unproved theorem rather than a conjecture or OEQ; relabel it as a conjecture only after defining the procedure, or as an OEQ with the conditional-LR construction as its handle.

soundness_flags.label: target_estimand and symbols theta_n, vartheta_n
soundness_flags.one_line: P_n is explicitly an observed-data law, so P_n{Y(0)=0|A=1,Y=1} and its PS analogue are undefined; define these under an admitted full-data extension (tilde P_n) and then state their observed-law identified functionals.

soundness_flags.label: def:score-cell-lr-inversion / thm:lr-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The conditional Poisson-binomial likelihood, profiled cell-intensity parameterization, and least-favorable conditional law are named but not defined, so the randomized inversion is not yet a measurable computable procedure over the nonparametric class M_n.

soundness_flags.label: thm:conditional-lan
soundness_flags.one_line: Rate compatibility is vacuous when n d_n<=log n, yet the theorem claims Gaussian recovery for every sequence with n d_n→infinity, including n d_n=o(log n); add a remainder condition for that regime or restrict the LAN assertion to a regime where the cross-fit score error is controlled.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:diameter-lower / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse uses only the certified covariate-homogeneous least-favorable submodel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lower rate is conditional for every measurable confidence-set procedure honest over a PN model class containing that stated least-favorable submodel.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the LR prose with an explicit conditional sample space, finite/sieve intensity parameter, profiling domain, randomization rule, and measurable inversion set; then retain it as a conjecture or OEQ until coverage is derived.

Correct the PN and PS causal targets to be full-data quantities and add a short identification lemma stating precisely why the displayed observed-law ratios are extension-invariant under the causal assumptions.

Split the Gaussian claim at the log-scale transition: prove a rare-count conditional experiment below it and impose a d_n-scaled cross-fit remainder condition for every diverging-effective-count LAN regime.
Add a worked no-covariate inversion instance showing the exact conditional likelihood, its least-favorable critical value, and recovery of the two-point lower-rate scale.

recommended_next_step: Revise the target-law notation and fully specify the conditional likelihood-ratio procedure, then relabel the open sharp-frontier kernel appropriately and resubmit the repaired field-tier proposal.
